'''Sa'arli''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Tarasin]] who served as an aide to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren|Lavina Wren]] of [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She had a tattoo of a snakelike lizard whose tail ran from her jawline to up around her ear-slit.<ref name="AMO">{{LivingForce|A Mon Alone}}</ref>

In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], second [[Standard year/Legends|year]] in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Sa'arli traveled to the [[Almas Academy]], to take part in a private ceremony of gratitude towards the heroes who defeated slaver [[Phylus Mon]]. On behalf of Senator Wren, Sa'arli awarded the heroes with the [[Hero of Cularin|Order of Cularin]].<ref name="AMO" />
